description.value: Cloudburst Coffee is a neighbourhood cafe on Mamquam Road in Squamish, a hub town for mountain biking, road cycling, and multi-day touring routes through the Sea-to-Sky corridor. The café operates seven days a week and appears family-friendly based on its OSM tags. Its location in Squamish makes it a practical stop for cyclists moving between Vancouver and Whistler.
